sky cinema premiere.desc: A couple realize their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

sky cinema premiere.title: Couples Weekend
sky cinema premiere.desc: Trapped in a cosy cabin by a blizzard, two couples ring in the new year with a mysterious cocktail that strips away their inhibitions, turning their romantic getaway into a showdown of secrets, betrayals and rapidly shifting loyalties.

sky cinema premiere.title: One Last Shot
sky cinema premiere.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defence network.

sky cinema premiere.title: How to Make a Killing
sky cinema premiere.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

sky cinema action.title: Green Lantern
sky cinema action.desc: A test pilot is granted a mystical green ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers, as well as membership into an intergalactic squadron tasked with keeping peace within the universe. Based on DC Comics characters.

sky cinema action.title: Jurassic World
sky cinema action.desc: Jurassic Park is now called Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, the realisation of owner John Hammond's dreams. The scientists may have gone too far in creating some sort of hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

sky cinema action.title: xXx
sky cinema action.desc: An extreme sports junkie is blackmailed by the CIA into taking on a highly dangerous mission to Prague in order to thwart the plans of a group of Russian extremists. The reluctant hero soon finds himself with the safety of the USA in his hands - and a complicated romance on the horizon.

sky cinema action.title: XXX 2: The Next Level
sky cinema action.desc: NSA Agent Augustus Gibbons, fresh off the success of his last renegade recruitment, once again finds himself in need of an outsider. Gibbons and his new agent must track a dangerous military splinter group that is conspiring to overthrow the US Government in the nation's capital.

sky cinema action.title: Olympus Has Fallen
sky cinema action.desc: America's national security team must rely on a disgraced former guard to save the president after terrorists seize control of the White House, taking the chief of state hostage.

sky cinema family.title: Chicken Run
sky cinema family.desc: Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent and they must devise other means of escape.

sky cinema family.title: Small Soldiers
sky cinema family.desc: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shop keeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shop keeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.

sky cinema family.title: Peter Rabbit
sky cinema family.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

sky cinema family.title: The BFG
sky cinema family.desc: A 10-year-old girl, Queen Victoria and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

sky cinema family.title: Goosebumps
sky cinema family.desc: A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author R.L. Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.

sky cinema comedy.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
sky cinema comedy.desc: A champion NASCAR driver's cosy position alongside his best friend at the top of the championship is threatened by a flamboyant French newcomer. With his confidence shattered, the driver draws on the help of his father and some eccentric training techniques to claw his way back to the top.

sky cinema comedy.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
sky cinema comedy.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
sky cinema comedy.desc: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

sky cinema comedy.title: Singin' in the Rain
sky cinema comedy.desc: When the transition is being made from silent films to `talkies', everyone has trouble adapting. Don and Lina have been cast repeatedly as a romantic couple, but when their latest film is remade into a musical, only Don has the voice for the new singing part. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.

sky cinema comedy.title: Zoolander 2
sky cinema comedy.desc: A special agent recruits former models Derek Zoolander and Hansel to save the world's most beautiful people from a deadly plot.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Cinema List: Men In Black Films
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: It is time to protect the Earth from the scum of the universe as we walk through how to join the Men in Black, learning from agents Will Smith, Tommy Lee Jones, and more.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Men in Black II
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Sequel to the sci-fi comedy about a top secret government task force set up to deal with unruly extraterrestrials. An MIB agent turns to the only man who can help him save the world from a rampaging, shape-shifting alien which has taken on the outward appearance of a sexy lingerie model.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Mad Max
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Mad Max 3: Beyond Thunderdome
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.

sky cinema thriller.title: Murder by Numbers
sky cinema thriller.desc: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Perfect Storm
sky cinema thriller.desc: Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.

sky cinema thriller.title: How to Make a Killing
sky cinema thriller.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Equalizer
sky cinema thriller.desc: A former commando who had faked his own death comes out of retirement to rescue a young girl from violent Russian mobsters.

sky cinema greats.title: My Girl
sky cinema greats.desc: Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend.

sky cinema greats.title: The Lion in Winter
sky cinema greats.desc: An epic historical drama set in the 12th century in which Henry II summons his fragmented family to a reunion. There follows a series of battles, both political and personal, as his wife Eleanor and her three sons scheme to further their own claim to the king's empire.

sky cinema greats.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
sky cinema greats.desc: A bittersweet story about a 43-year-old woman on the verge of divorce who magically travels back in time to her senior high-school years. She is able to act with the benefit of hindsight, but despite her efforts, she falls for the same boy all over again.

sky cinema greats.title: Terms of Endearment
sky cinema greats.desc: While widow Aurora fends off a stream of admirers, daughter Emma learns the hard facts of married life.

sky cinema greats.title: Chaplin
sky cinema greats.desc: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charlie Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972.

sky cinema drama.title: Cookster: The Darkest Days
sky cinema drama.desc: A dyslexic teen misunderstood by his family and desperate for respect, becomes a drug dealer struggling with addiction and debt while a rival threatens to destroy his world, driving him apart from the woman he loves.

sky cinema drama.title: My Girl 2
sky cinema drama.desc: Now 13, Vada Sultenfuss is given a school project to write about someone she has never met. Researching the life of her mother, who died when she was a baby, Vada visits her uncle to gather more information and strikes up a friendship with his girlfriend's son. Together, they attempt to solve the mysteries of her mother's life.

sky cinema drama.title: Love Me
sky cinema drama.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

sky cinema drama.title: Better Man
sky cinema drama.desc: The true story of the meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence of British pop superstar Robbie Williams.

cartoonito.title: Fireman Sam
cartoonito.desc: Protecting the citizens of the Welsh town of Pontypandy. Whenever the alarm sounds, brave Sam and his co-workers can be counted on to jump into a fire engine, hop onto a helicopter, and more, to help those in need.
